subtitle: Agricultural Management Platform

glassmorphism.usage: Headers, Navbars, Modal Overlays, Premium Tier Cards
glassmorphism.classes: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]

solid_cards.usage: Dashboard Widgets, Data Tables, Standard KPI Cards
solid_cards.classes: bg-white rounded-xl border border-stone-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

surfaces_and_shadows.radius: rounded-xl for main cards, rounded-md for inputs/buttons

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Control Room Grid. High data density but visually clean. Utilize full height, clear alignments.

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Square or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Strict hover states with lighter hue.
components.inputs: Shadcn based. White bg, stone-200 border, focus ring with primary emerald.
components.charts: Recharts. Use monochromatic or earthy palettes (emerald, sage, terracotta). No default bright colors.
components.icons: lucide-react. Stroke width 1.5 for a premium, lightweight tech feel. NO EMOJIS.
components.navigation: Top premium header with glassmorphism + Desktop Sidebar (flat, stone-900 or stone-50) / Mobile Bottom Nav.

tractor_field.description: Green tractor with sprayer attachment in a field
tractor_field.usage: Hero section background, Equipment inventory placeholder, or Land parcel image

wheat_field.usage: Crop management module header, Farm overview card

silos.description: Farm buildings and wind turbines at sunset
silos.usage: Inventory/Warehouse module, premium subscription banner background

strict_rules: NO cartoon illustrations or childish UI patterns.
NO emojis anywhere in the app (use Lucide icons instead).
MUST feel like a professional ERP or Bloomberg terminal for agriculture.
MUST use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Ensure high contrast and readability on all cards and charts.
instructions_to_main_agent: Use this JSON strictly. Setup Shadcn components with the provided radii and colors. Apply Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body. Build the dashboard using the 'Control Room Grid' logic for dense, organized data cards. Incorporate the provided Unsplash images in their respective modules to add realism. Integrate Recharts using the earthy green/terracotta palette.
